caption: The drawing depicts a grayscale, front-facing architectural facade composed of simple geometric shapes. The building has a gabled roof and smooth walls. In the upper section, there is a small rectangular window or opening with a protruding ledge above it, set symmetrically at the center. The lower section depicts a horizontal band of brick texture, which sits above three large, evenly spaced archways that serve as entryways. Below the building is a ribbon-like banner with text. The banner is divided into two parts: on the left, it reads "1797" and on the longer right section, it reads "Mision San Juan Bautista." The overall composition is centered on a light, unshaded background, and all elements are rendered in shades of black, gray, and white.
title: Mision San Juan Bautista
